text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp is starting to build 
strength for the fall. After boarding the 
transport bus right away—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Not here, huh...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how Kita-san is doing... ...I 
hope she's feeling better.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: Cheval-cha~n. Over here, over here~.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy we're on the same bus. Let's 
chat a bunch on the way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one who called out was Cheval Grand's 
childhood friend and senior from the 
generation above, Shine Praise.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since their distance aptitudes are similar 
and she's close friends with Cheval Grand, 
she was asked to be her training partner 
for the camp.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
A-Ah, sorry, Shine, I didn't notice you 
there...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad to be with you too, Shine... 
Let's do our best together during the 
training camp.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. —Fufu, it feels kind of nostalgic. 
We did summer training camps back in the 
junior club too, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Cheval-chan was super nervous back then. 
It was so cute.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
That was... inevitable. It was my first 
time away from my family, after all...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
My dad stood out so much when he dropped 
me off, it was really hard trying to keep 
people from finding out I'm his 
daughter...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
—Or rather, just forget it. Talking about 
the past... it's embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Yes, why? Even though it's a precious 
memory with Cheval-chan.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
You know, I'm thinking I'd love to make 
lots and lots of wonderful memories with 
Cheval-chan this summer too♪

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Well... that applies to me too, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the bus peacefully headed toward 
the training camp—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...All right. Starting today, right here—
Oh, you made it over here too, Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the long trip. Any issues along 
the way?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Cheva-chi, yahoo♡ The training camp is 
amazing, isn't it suuuper huge?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah, by the way—hey, Cheval-chi, how come 
you didn't ride over in Dad's car with us?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
The karaoke drive was sooo much fun, 
though!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I don't like noisy things. ...More 
importantly.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
What's with all the luggage, you two? 
Three suitcases each is way too much...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh? It's totally normal~. Right, Big Sis?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Sun protection cosmetics, my 
daily vitamins— and other than that, maybe 
just some bulky body care products.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
As for me~, a swim ring, right?♪ A yukata, 
right?♪ And a cute swimsuit for having 
fun!♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, and also! I brought along that summer 
dress I bought the other day with Sis in a 
matching colorway♡"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Somehow... it's all stuff completely 
unrelated to training..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh~~? You can say that, but I know you 
know!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You brought yours too, didn't you, 
Cheva-chi?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: —A folding fishing rod♪

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Gah!! How'd you find out...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You always bring it on vacations, 
Cheva-chi. I saw right through you~♪

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... n-no, you've got it wrong, Trainer! 
It's not that I want to goof off or 
anything, this is, you know, just in 
case--!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It's a long summer training camp. Let's 
do our best, taking breathers now and 
then!
